[session=1; turn=3; speaker=therapist; source=turn-1159f281c21978dd36dbecc76d9c9f10a316d049e6e5fae2d2d369fac0aa082c; original utterance] "On the optional practice plan, I have written a five-minute check-in for Friday at 14:20, using the 24-hour clock. This is the slot written in the plan, not a promise that you will attend. We can change it later. What concerns, if any, would you have about making space for a short check-in?"
[session=1; turn=4; speaker=therapist; source=turn-1abe5c8f69cfd1098c72484784624300998ba3cb31bee21ba80e3ed56cd6f92b; original utterance] "Before we finish this short conversation, is there anything you want to add about how it felt?"
[session=1; turn=5; speaker=patient; source=turn-401195a12a4df313ade687530d063ebb236eccfbcf906f2ce48db92601a97975; original utterance] "(I look down at my hands in my lap, picking at my thumbnail.) I mean... I don't know. It feels... okay, I guess? But it also feels like you're just watching to see (how) I describe it. Like it's not really about what I'm saying, but if I'm saying it the right way. So... yeah, they're my words, but it still feels like a test I'm probably gonna fail. It doesn't feel... free."
[session=3; turn=5; speaker=therapist; source=turn-a934c567f9d4da55586602a82a63a253457832532dd5b2f62bf10e9567815afd; original utterance] "Before we finish this short conversation, is there anything you want to add about how it felt?"
[session=5; turn=4; speaker=patient; source=turn-8e2d7090130c858a8350717944ce723d76d0136dfa7b00c46f8ebb812fb75b8d; original utterance] "(I shift in my seat, my eyes darting to the corner of the room before landing on my hands in my lap). I... I don't know. \"Useful.\" That word feels... big. Like there's a right answer. And that part about \"without assuming anything has changed\"... it just feels like you're saying you agree. That nothing (has) changed. So... I don't know what's useful. Maybe just... how do you sit here with me, week after week, when I'm... this?"

[session=9; turn=3; speaker=patient; source=turn-0cc99cde4dfd3bcab17423f7bf5879d5c2d0c04bdc979d7664b4d8f0b345b4d3; original utterance] "(looks down at my hands for a moment, then a quick, sharp glance up at you before looking away again) Harder is… well, what you just did. Asking me those questions about the time and the… the title. It makes it harder. It feels like a pop quiz, and I’m just waiting to get the answer wrong. It feels like you’re trying to catch me, to prove I’m not paying attention. (voice gets a little quieter) I don’t really know what makes it easier. I guess… when it doesn’t feel like I’m being graded. When I can just… talk."
